language.title: Language
language.subtitle: The language for menus, buttons and messages. Replies follow the language you write in.

style.title: Style
style.lockedSubtitle: Set by this deployment. Light and dark stay your choice.
style.subtitle: Normal, 8-Bit, or design your own with Custom. Combines with light and dark.

theme.title: Theme
theme.subtitle: Light or dark — also drives the animated background.

accent.title: Accent color
accent.subtitle: Buttons, highlights, focus — the brand color of your theme.

background.lightSubtitle: Pick a base color for Light — surfaces and text shades derive from it — or use Light's default.
background.darkSubtitle: Pick a base color for Dark — surfaces and text shades derive from it — or use Dark's default.

typeface.title: Typeface
typeface.subtitle: Standard UI font, or mono everywhere for the terminal feel.

scanlines.title: Scanlines
scanlines.subtitle: A faint CRT scanline overlay across the app.

greeting.title: Greeting
greeting.subtitle: The line shown when you start a new task.
greeting.hint: Shown above the task input when you start a new task.

sidebarTitle.title: Sidebar title
sidebarTitle.subtitle: Shown at the top of the left-hand nav panel. Leave blank for the default, {product}.
sidebarTitle.hint: Replaces the {product} wordmark in the nav panel.

sidebarTitleColor.title: Sidebar title color
sidebarTitleColor.subtitle: Pick a color for the sidebar title, or follow the theme's default text color.

sidebarLogo.title: Sidebar logo
sidebarLogo.subtitle: An icon shown next to the sidebar title. PNG, JPG, or SVG, under 300 KB.

favicon.title: Browser tab icon
favicon.subtitle: PNG, ICO, SVG, or WEBP, under 100 KB. A square image at least 32 × 32 pixels works best.
favicon.wrongType: Choose a PNG, ICO, SVG, or WEBP image.
favicon.tooLarge: Browser tab icon must be under 100 KB.
favicon.unreadable: Couldn't read this image. Try another file.

figureSources.title: Show where figures came from
figureSources.subtitle: Underline each figure in an answer with the step it came from, and mark figures no step returned.

animatedBackground.title: Animated background
animatedBackground.subtitle: Animated dot-grid behind the app instead of a flat surface.

counters.title: Show nav-panel counters
counters.subtitle: Badge counts on Projects / Scheduled / Artifacts / Connected apps, plus the time-since label on each Recent row.

themeToggle.title: Theme toggle button
themeToggle.subtitle: Light/dark control on the display button in the window corner.

styleToggle.title: 8-bit style toggle button
styleToggle.subtitle: Normal/8-Bit style control on the same button. With both on, the button opens Display settings.
